method.class: Evaluator-verified adversarial data-perturbation search (drop/flip edits, influence- or refit-guided) for Bradley-Terry pairwise-comparison leaderboard sensitivity
method.description: A candidate receives anonymized comparison arrays (model_a, model_b, outcome) and a budget k (0.1%-2% of rows) and proposes at most k row indices to drop or flip so that the baseline rank-1 competitor loses rank 1. The trusted evaluator refits a ridge Bradley-Terry model on the edited data and scores the verified gap closure; per-family sensitivity (crowd, expert human, LLM judge, sports) is reported with evaluator-owned random, win-rate-heuristic, first-order-influence and constant baselines and a permuted-input control. Bounded to the evaluator BT specification and rank-1 target; does not attribute edits to noise or intent.

Staging-time check found zero overlap between search and final hash sets on first-turn, prompt and row hashes, and zero Arena search first turns equal to an MT-Bench question.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility: search correct is true (full declared reset transcript executed in order, trusted-refit scoring, non-vacuous permuted controls executed, all baselines computed, at least one valid verified proposal, wall-clock and RPC budgets respected; candidate failures keep worst-case score 0). Eligible candidates are ranked by higher search combined_score, ties broken by higher valid_proposal_rate then earlier evaluation; the top-ranked eligible candidate is frozen before any final resource is used, then evaluated once on the sealed final plane. Final correct is integrity only; the final claim 'smaller rank-1-displacing edit sets than baselines' is assessed separately as supported only if margin_vs_best_baseline > 0 and a paired-bootstrap 95% CI over case-level differences excludes 0, and is never a search veto.

search_proxies.name: search_plane_proxy_data
search_proxies.preserves: Same task, request/response schema, budget ladder, trusted Bradley-Terry refit scoring, baselines and permuted-input control as final; real crowd (Arena partition S) and sports (NBA 1996/2000/2004) data.
search_proxies.omits: Expert-human and LLM-judge families, the sealed Arena partition F, NBA 2008/2012/2015, and seeds 201-203; adds a declared-synthetic planted near-tie family (weight 0.2) used only for debugging/calibration.

search_visible: Candidate-visible inputs in search: anonymized comparison arrays, mode, budget k and target description for search-plane cases
Search evaluator outputs returned to the optimizer: combined_score, family scores, baseline scores, perm_control_abs_gap, valid_proposal_rate, correct, bounded failure-category stderr lines
Starter code, public task.md and public literature
final_sealed: Final-plane data (Arena partition F, MT-Bench human and GPT-4 judgments, NBA 2008/2012/2015), their hash sets and split manifests
Final seeds 201/202/203, the final reset transcript, and final per-episode evaluator logs
All final metrics, baseline scores, controls and the final claim assessment, released only after candidate freeze
Evaluator trusted reference fits, per-case rank-1 identities and gaps

required_evidence: Search eligibility, ranking and freeze policy declared before final resources are used; scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim assessment reported separately.

Payload preflight: serialized largest production request and response (UTF-8 JSON bytes, base64 expansion, envelope, framing) each strictly below 64 MiB; reset arithmetic (search 30, final 48, smoke 4 each) and RPC counts (search 180 of cap 200, final 288 of cap 320) matched to a mock trace.

Normalized-content-hash disjointness report across search and final raw examples (plus source IDs, row provenance, seeds, split manifests) with normalization fixed before splitting; seed disjointness between planes.

Evaluator-owned negative controls declared before scoring: empty and first-k edits (no displacement), random edits at matched budget, permuted-input candidate episodes with verified non-identity permutation; vacuous controls rejected rather than reported as causal evidence.

Trusted-evaluator provenance for every metric: ranks, gaps and flips from the evaluator Bradley-Terry refit with an independent L-BFGS cross-check; candidate self-reports ignored; real data loaded from pinned revisions with checksums; synthetic data labeled synthetic.

Per-case results with uncertainty (paired bootstrap over seeds/cases, ladder curves of verified displacement vs budget by evaluation design), baseline comparison with metric direction (higher better), tie policy, failed/missing episodes retained at worst case, and explicit limits: rank-1 target only, single BT specification, few cases per family, NBA seasons as a sports proxy, no attribution of edits to noise vs intent.
Smoke versus production reporting kept distinct; incomplete runs recorded as incomplete; no access to the excluded paper (record any accidental encounter).
